regulation: APPI (Act on the Protection of Personal Information), JPMA Code, MR Certification

rules.description: Personal information requires consent for collection and use. Cross-border data transfer requires additional consent or equivalent safeguards.
rules.implementation: Consent Management must track: purpose of use, cross-border transfer consent separately. Data residency may require Japan-based data center or additional contractual safeguards.
rules.penalty: Up to ¥100M for corporations, criminal penalties for individuals

rules.description: Medical Representatives (MRs) must be certified by MR Education Center. CRM must support MR certification tracking and visit compliance.
rules.implementation: User Management must track MR certification status and expiration. Visit Management should validate that only certified MRs conduct product detailing visits.

rules.description: Japan Pharmaceutical Manufacturers Association self-regulatory code governs HCP interactions, hospitality, and promotional activities.
rules.implementation: Visit Management and Events Management must enforce: (1) Meal/hospitality caps per interaction, (2) Promotional material approval tracking, (3) Off-label discussion prohibition enforcement.

rules.description: Japan's pharmaceutical sample regulations differ from US PDMA. Samples classified as 'trial-use drugs' have specific handling requirements.
rules.implementation: Sample Management must support: (1) Trial-use drug classification, (2) Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare reporting requirements, (3) Different lot tracking granularity than US/EU.

migration_notes: Japan implementations often have unique customizations due to MR culture and JPMA requirements. Key migration considerations: (1) MR visit patterns (high-frequency, short-duration) may require different Activity Plan configuration than Western markets, (2) Language/localization: full Japanese UI and data support required, (3) Data residency: confirm target platform's data center location meets APPI cross-border requirements.

citation.confidence: Medium — fewer production deployments to reference
